## Headline
Manage 10 Rooftops from One Screen.

## The Problem
You acquired three new stores. You're running operations from two states away. Every location uses the same CRM but the data lives in silos. You can't see what's happening at the Cookeville stores without calling someone. Your new staff is "salt of the earth" — capable, but cautious about new technology. You need visibility without disruption.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 22:40-24:04]

## The CXM Solution
CarBot Cloud CXM connects all rooftops into a single dashboard. Every call happening at every location appears in real time. Every lead, every follow-up, every AI interaction — visible from wherever you are. New stores start with the familiar Outlook-style interface. No retraining. No disruption. Just visibility.

## How It Works
1. **Day 1**: CXM connects to your CRM across all locations. All lead and customer data flows in.
2. **Week 1**: Staff at new locations see their familiar email-style interface. They work leads the same way — CXM just shows everything in one place.
3. **Week 2-4**: AI begins handling after-hours leads and routine follow-ups. Your team sees the results in their dashboard.
4. **Month 2+**: Layer in AI coaching, instant lead verification, and workflow automation as the team is ready.

## Key Capabilities
- Multi-location real-time dashboard
- Per-location and consolidated views
- Familiar UI for new/traditional staff
- Gradual AI adoption path
- Remote management without on-site presence

## Who It's For
- Operating partners managing acquisitions
- GMs overseeing multiple locations
- Regional managers who can't be everywhere at once
